performance_case.claim_boundary: Acceptance proves only the source bytes for one three-file Maven distribution and zero-argument CLI slice. It cannot prove compilation, package bytes, endpoint reliability, Unix enforcement, PackageOnly, deployment, registration, forward evidence, prediction, fees, slippage, matched-capital PnL, drawdown, candidate readiness, OOS or Trading authority.
performance_case.drawdown_hypothesis: Immediate drawdown effect is zero. Any future drawdown reduction remains MISSING_PROOF until lawful prospective carry evidence supports a separately preregistered matched-capital Validation and sealed OOS result.
performance_case.opportunity_cost: A dedicated stale-safe Maven package and one fixed request-driven source entrypoint remove the repeatable Windows direct-javac/zipfs bottleneck while preventing broad application packaging, caller-path drift, duplicate timers and premature server work.
performance_case.performance_hypothesis: This source-package slice cannot improve fee-adjusted total PnL directly, but it reduces learning latency and integrity risk by making the already accepted carry V2 evidence path independently buildable before spending server or prospective-data capacity.
